## Visualizando funciones {.title-line}

```{python}
#| echo: false
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

_CR = '#c0392b'
_BL = '#2980b9'
_GO = 'goldenrod'
_GR = '#0000004a'

_xp = np.linspace(-2, 2, 300)
_yp = _xp**2

_th = np.linspace(0, 2*np.pi, 300)
_xc = np.cos(_th)
_yc = 2 + np.sin(_th)

_xs = np.linspace(0, 2, 200)
_ys_p = np.sqrt(_xs)
_ys_n = -np.sqrt(_xs)

def _ax_par(ax):
    ax.set_xlim(-2.3, 2.3)
    ax.set_ylim(-0.3, 4.3)
    ax.set_xticks([-2, -1, 0, 1, 2])
    ax.set_yticks([0, 1, 2, 3, 4])
    ax.set_xlabel('X', color=_GR, fontsize=11)
    ax.set_ylabel('Y', color=_GR, fontsize=11, rotation=0, labelpad=12)
    for s in ['top', 'right']:
        ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
    for s in ['bottom', 'left']:
        ax.spines[s].set_color(_GR)
    ax.tick_params(colors=_GR, labelsize=9)

def _ax_sq(ax):
    ax.set_xlim(-2.3, 2.3)
    ax.set_ylim(-1.7, 1.7)
    ax.set_xticks([-2, -1, 0, 1, 2])
    ax.set_yticks([-1, 0, 1])
    ax.set_xlabel('X', color=_GR, fontsize=11)
    ax.set_ylabel('Y', color=_GR, fontsize=11, rotation=0, labelpad=12)
    for s in ['top', 'right']:
        ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
    for s in ['bottom', 'left']:
        ax.spines[s].set_color(_GR)
    ax.tick_params(colors=_GR, labelsize=9)
```

## ¿Qué es una función? {.title-line}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding: 1em 3em 1em 2em; gap: 1.2em; text-align: center;"}

::: {style="font-size: 2.8em;"}
${\color{goldenrod}y} = {\color{#c0392b}f}({\color{teal}x})$
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=1 style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.9em; font-size: 1.1em; max-width: 55em; line-height: 1.6;"}

::: {style="color: teal; font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.15em;"}
Punto sutil:
:::

::: {style="color: navy;"}
[$f$]{style="color: #c0392b; font-style: italic;"} es la(s) regla(s) que mapea variables independientes ([$x$]{style="color: teal;"}) hacia variables dependientes ([$y$]{style="color: goldenrod;"}).
:::

::: {style="color: goldenrod;"}
[$y$]{style="font-style: italic;"} es un valor particular de la salida de una función para un valor particular de [$x$]{style="color: teal;"}.
:::

:::

:::

## Dominio y rango {.title-line}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding: 1em 3em 1em 2em; gap: 2.2em; font-size: 1.15em;"}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: row; align-items: baseline; gap: 1.2em;"}
::: {style="flex: 0 0 9em; color: #888; font-style: italic; text-align: right; font-size: 1.05em;"}
Dominio:
:::
::: {style="flex: 1; color: goldenrod; line-height: 1.5;"}

```{python}
    ax.set_yticks([0, 1, 2, 3, 4])
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=9)
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    return fig, ax
```

## Dominio y rango en abstracto {.title-line}

```{python}
#| echo: false
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import Ellipse, Circle

# Colores
_CR_A = '#b34533'   # terracota — dominio
_BL_A = '#1a3a9e'   # azul oscuro — rango
_GO_A = '#c89020'   # dorado — "Todo x"
_TL_A = '#00897b'   # teal — "Todo y" y flecha

# Geometría de cajas (coordenadas normalizadas 0-1)
_LBX, _LBY, _LBW, _LBH = 0.04, 0.10, 0.34, 0.78
_RBX, _RBY, _RBW, _RBH = 0.62, 0.10, 0.34, 0.78
_PAD = 0.022

def _make_frame_ab():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5, 5.5))
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax.axis('off')
    fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (_LBX, _LBY), _LBW, _LBH,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.025", lw=2.8, ls=(0, (5, 4)),
        ec=_GO_A, fc='none', zorder=1))
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (_RBX, _RBY), _RBW, _RBH,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.025", lw=2.8, ls=(0, (5, 4)),
        ec=_TL_A, fc='none', zorder=1))
    ax.text(_LBX+0.01, _LBY+_LBH-0.01, 'Todo x',
            fontsize=14, color=_GO_A, style='italic', fontweight='bold',
            va='top', ha='left', zorder=5)
    ax.text(_RBX+_RBW-0.01, _RBY+_RBH-0.01, 'Todo y',
            fontsize=14, color=_TL_A, style='italic', fontweight='bold',
            va='top', ha='right', zorder=5)
    ax.text(_LBX+_LBW/2, _LBY-0.04, r'$D(f)$',
            fontsize=12, color=_CR_A, ha='center', va='top', style='italic', zorder=5)
    ax.text(_RBX+_RBW/2, _RBY-0.04, r'$R(f)$',
            fontsize=12, color=_TL_A, ha='center', va='top', style='italic', zorder=5)
    return fig, ax

def _filled_rect_ab(ax, bx, by, bw, bh, frac_y0, frac_y1, color):
    y0 = by + bh * frac_y0 + _PAD
    y1 = by + bh * frac_y1 - _PAD
    if y1 - y0 <= 0:
        return
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (bx+_PAD, y0), bw-2*_PAD, y1-y0,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.018", lw=0,
        ec='none', fc=color, zorder=2))

def _arrow_ab(ax, src, dst, formula, rad=-0.28):
    ax.annotate('', xy=dst, xytext=src,
        arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=_TL_A, lw=3.0,
                        connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}'), zorder=6)
    mx = (src[0]+dst[0])/2
    my = (src[1]+dst[1])/2 + 0.11
    ax.text(mx, my, formula, fontsize=13, color=_TL_A,
            ha='center', va='bottom', style='italic', zorder=6)
```

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding: 0.3em 1em;"}

::: {.r-stack style="flex: 1; min-height: 0; width: 100%;"}

::: {style="width: 100%; height: 100%;"}
```{python}
#| echo: false
# Estado 0: f(x) = x² — dominio=ℝ (caja izq completa), rango=[0,∞) (parte superior derecha)
fig, ax = _make_frame_ab()
_filled_rect_ab(ax, _LBX, _LBY, _LBW, _LBH, 0.0, 1.0, _CR_A)
_filled_rect_ab(ax, _RBX, _RBY, _RBW, _RBH, 0.44, 1.0, _BL_A)
_arrow_ab(ax, (_LBX+_LBW+0.01, _LBY+_LBH*0.78),
              (_RBX-0.01, _RBY+_RBH*0.78), r'$y = f(x) = x^2$')
plt.tight_layout(pad=0.3)
plt.show()
```

## Intuición geométrica: Funciones lineales vs no lineales {.title-line}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding: 0.2em 1em;"}
```{python}
#| echo: false
#| results: 'hide'
x = np.linspace(-3, 4, 600)

# No lineales
y_cr  = 0.62 * np.exp(-0.75 * (x + 0.4)**2) + 0.04 * x      # curva gaussiana (crimson)
y_sin = 0.52 * np.sin(2.3 * x)                                 # onda sinusoidal (teal)

# Lineales
y_bl = 0.13 * x + 0.22                                         # recta azul suave
y_go = 0.40 * x + 0.02                                         # recta dorada más inclinada

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.8, 5.4))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')

# Líneas de referencia punteadas
ax.axvline(x=-0.45, color='gray', lw=1.0, ls='--', alpha=0.6, zorder=1)
ax.axhline(y=0.22,  color='gray', lw=1.0, ls='--', alpha=0.6, zorder=1)

# Funciones no lineales
ax.plot(x, y_cr,  color=_CR,       lw=2.3, zorder=3)
ax.plot(x, y_sin, color='teal',    lw=2.3, zorder=3)

# Funciones lineales
ax.plot(x, y_bl,  color='#2475b0', lw=2.3, zorder=3)          # azul
ax.plot(x, y_go,  color='goldenrod', lw=2.3, zorder=3)         # dorado
ax.axvline(x=1.55, color='navy',   lw=2.3, zorder=3)           # vertical navy

ax.set_xlim(-3, 4)
ax.set_ylim(-0.82, 0.88)
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout(pad=0.2)
plt.show()
```
:::

## Definición algebraica #1: Lineal vs no lineal {.title-line}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding: 1em 3.5em 1em 2em; gap: 1.5em;"}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 2.5em; flex: 0 0 auto;"}

::: {style="flex: 1; border-left: 4px solid goldenrod; padding-left: 1em;"}
[**Lineal:**]{style="color: goldenrod; font-size: 1.05em;"} La función puede simplificarse a

::: {style="margin: -0.4em 0; text-align: center;"}
$${\color{goldenrod}y} = {\color{goldenrod}m}{\color{teal}x} + {\color{goldenrod}b}$$
:::
:::

::: {style="flex: 1; border-left: 4px solid #c0392b; padding-left: 1em;"}
[**No lineal:**]{style="color: #c0392b; font-size: 1.05em;"} La función **NO** puede simplificarse a

::: {style="margin: -0.4em 0; text-align: center;"}
$${\color{#c0392b}y} = {\color{#c0392b}m}{\color{teal}x} + {\color{#c0392b}b}$$
:::
:::

:::

::: {.r-stack style="flex: 1; min-height: 0;"}

::: {style="width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 8em;"}
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=1 style="width: 100%; height: 100%; background: white; display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 2.5em; align-items: flex-start; padding-top: 0.5em;"}

::: {style="flex: 1; text-align: center;"}

::: {style="margin: -0.4em 0;"}
$${\color{#c0392b}y} = 2{\color{teal}x} + 6$$
:::

:::

::: {style="flex: 1;"}
:::

:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=2 style="width: 100%; height: 100%; background: white; display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 2.5em; align-items: flex-start; padding-top: 0.5em;"}

::: {style="flex: 1; text-align: center;"}

::: {style="margin: -0.4em 0;"}
$${\color{#c0392b}y} = 2{\color{teal}x} + 6$$
:::

:::

::: {style="flex: 1; text-align: center;"}

::: {style="margin: -0.4em 0;"}
$${\color{teal}x}{\color{#c0392b}y} = 3{\color{teal}x}^2 - 4{\color{teal}x}$$
:::

:::

:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=3 style="width: 100%; height: 100%; background: white; display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 2.5em; align-items: flex-start; padding-top: 0.5em;"}

::: {style="flex: 1; text-align: center;"}

::: {style="margin: -0.4em 0;"}
$${\color{#c0392b}y} = 2\sqrt{\cos({\color{teal}x})} + 6$$
:::

:::

::: {style="flex: 1; text-align: center;"}

::: {style="margin: -0.4em 0;"}
$${\color{#c0392b}y} = 3{\color{teal}x}^2 - 4$$
:::

:::

:::

:::

$${\color{goldenrod}y} = 2\sqrt{\cos({\color{teal}x})} + 6$$
:::

::: {style="margin: -0.4em 0;"}
$${\color{goldenrod}y} = 3{\color{teal}x}^2 - 4$$
:::

:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=4 style="width: 100%; height: 100%; background: white; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; padding-top: 0.8em;"}

::: {style="margin: -0.4em 0;"}
$${\color{goldenrod}y} = \sqrt{2}{\color{teal}x} + \cos(6)$$
:::

:::

:::

:::

## Definición algebraica #1-b-: Lineal vs no lineal {.title-line}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: row; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding: 0.8em 3.5em 0.8em 1.5em; gap: 2em; align-items: flex-start;"}

::: {style="flex: 0 0 36%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2.8em; padding-top: 1em;"}

Lineal:
:::

::: {style="flex: 1; margin: -0.4em 0;"}
$$\frac{\Delta{\color{goldenrod}y}}{\Delta{\color{teal}x}} = {\color{navy}c}$$

No lineal:
:::

::: {style="flex: 1; margin: -0.4em 0;"}
$$\frac{\Delta{\color{goldenrod}y}}{\Delta{\color{teal}x}} \neq {\color{navy}c}$$
:::

## Funciones con subdominios lineales {.title-line}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-height: 0; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 0.3em 3.5em 0.3em 1em;"}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| results: 'hide'
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13.5, 7.0))
fig.patch.set_alpha(0)

_gold = '#b8860b'
_dash = '#aaaaaa'

def _ax_clean(ax):
    ax.set_facecolor('none')
    for s in ax.spines.values():
        s.set_visible(False)
    ax.set_xticks([])
    ax.set_yticks([])

_ax_clean(ax1)
_ax_clean(ax2)

# LEFT: piecewise — segmento recto luego segmento curvo
xb1 = 0.3
xl1 = np.linspace(-2.4, xb1, 250)
yl1 = 1.1 * xl1 - 0.2
yb1 = 1.1 * xb1 - 0.2
xc1 = np.linspace(xb1, 2.2, 300)
yc1 = yb1 + 1.1*(xc1 - xb1) + 1.5*(xc1 - xb1)**2
ax1.plot(xl1, yl1, color=_gold, lw=2.2, zorder=3)
ax1.plot(xc1, yc1, color=_gold, lw=2.2, zorder=3)
ax1.axhline(yb1, color=_dash, ls='--', lw=0.9)
ax1.axvline(xb1, color=_dash, ls='--', lw=0.9)
ax1.set_xlim(-2.6, 2.5)
ax1.set_ylim(-3.0, 6.0)

# RIGHT: dos rectas con pendientes distintas, sin curvas
xb2 = 0.0
xl2 = np.linspace(-2.5, xb2, 250)
yl2 = 0.6 * xl2 - 0.15
yb2 = 0.6 * xb2 - 0.15
xr2 = np.linspace(xb2, 2.5, 250)
yr2 = yb2 + 2.5 * (xr2 - xb2)
ax2.plot(xl2, yl2, color=_gold, lw=2.2, zorder=3)
ax2.plot(xr2, yr2, color=_gold, lw=2.2, zorder=3)
ax2.axhline(yb2, color=_dash, ls='--', lw=0.9)
ax2.axvline(xb2, color=_dash, ls='--', lw=0.9)

plt.tight_layout(pad=1.5)
plt.show()
```

:::

## Funciones lineales vs afines {.title-line}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: row; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding: 0.5em 3.5em 0.5em 1.5em; gap: 1.5em; align-items: center;"}

::: {style="flex: 0 0 58%;"}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| results: 'hide'
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 4.5))
fig.patch.set_alpha(0)
ax.set_facecolor('none')
for s in ax.spines.values():
    s.set_visible(False)
ax.set_xticks([])
ax.set_yticks([])

x = np.linspace(-2.5, 3.0, 300)

# Lineal: pasa por el origen
ax.plot(x, 1.8*x, color='#c0392b', lw=2.3, zorder=3)

# Afín: no pasa por el origen (desplazada)
ax.plot(x, 0.65*x + 1.2, color='#b8860b', lw=2.3, zorder=3)

# Líneas de referencia punteadas en el origen
ax.axhline(0, color='#aaaaaa', ls='--', lw=0.9)
ax.axvline(0, color='#aaaaaa', ls='--', lw=0.9)

ax.set_xlim(-2.5, 3.0)
ax.set_ylim(-4.0, 5.0)
plt.tight_layout(pad=0.3)
plt.show()
```

:::

::: {style="display: flex; gap: 0.6em; align-items: flex-start; color: navy;"}
● Aritmética con polinomios.
:::

::: {style="display: flex; gap: 0.6em; align-items: flex-start; color: teal;"}

## ¿Qué son los polinomios? {.title-line}

::: {.r-stack style="width: 100%; height: 100%; padding-right: 3.5em;"}

::: {style="background: white; width: 100%; min-height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5em;font-size: 1.35em;"}

$${\color{#c0392b}y} = {\color{goldenrod}a_0} + {\color{goldenrod}a_1}{\color{teal}x} + {\color{goldenrod}a_2}{\color{teal}x}^2 + \ldots + {\color{goldenrod}a_n}{\color{teal}x}^n$$

:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=1 style="background: white; width: 100%; min-height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5em;"}

[**Coeficientes**]{style="color: goldenrod; font-size: 0.9em; letter-spacing: 0.05em;"}

$${\color{#c0392b}y} = \boxed{{\color{goldenrod}a_0}} + \boxed{{\color{goldenrod}a_1}}{\color{teal}x} + \boxed{{\color{goldenrod}a_2}}{\color{teal}x}^2 + \ldots + \boxed{{\color{goldenrod}a_n}}{\color{teal}x}^n$$

:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=2 style="background: white; width: 100%; min-height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.4em;"}

$${\color{#c0392b}y} = {\color{goldenrod}a_0} + {\color{goldenrod}a_1}{\color{teal}x} + {\color{goldenrod}a_2}{\color{teal}x}^2 + \ldots + {\color{goldenrod}a_n}{\color{teal}x}^n$$

$$= {\color{goldenrod}a_0}{\color{teal}x}^0 + {\color{goldenrod}a_1}{\color{teal}x}^1 + {\color{goldenrod}a_2}{\color{teal}x}^2 + \ldots + {\color{goldenrod}a_n}{\color{teal}x}^n$$

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=3}

$$= \sum_{i=0}^{n} {\color{goldenrod}a_i}{\color{teal}x}^i$$

:::

:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=4 style="background: white; width: 100%; min-height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.8em;"}

$$f({\color{teal}x}) = {\color{goldenrod}3} - {\color{goldenrod}5}{\color{teal}x} + \frac{{\color{goldenrod}5}}{6}{\color{teal}x}^2 + {\color{goldenrod}12.4}{\color{teal}x}^3$$

$$g({\color{teal}x}) = {\color{goldenrod}2}{\color{teal}x} + {\color{teal}x}^3$$

:::

:::

## Visualización de polinomios {.title-line}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding-right: 3.5em; align-items: center; justify-content: center;"}

```{python}
#| echo: false
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = np.linspace(-2, 2, 400)

_polys = [
    (0, r'$y = x^0$', 'goldenrod'),
    (1, r'$y = x^1$', '#c0392b'),
    (2, r'$y = x^2$', 'teal'),
    (3, r'$y = x^3$', 'navy'),
    (4, r'$y = x^4$', '#26a69a'),
    (5, r'$y = x^5$', '#111111'),
]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(14, 7.2))
fig.patch.set_alpha(0)

for ax, (n, title, color) in zip(axes.flat, _polys):
    ax.plot(x, x**n, color=color, lw=2.2, zorder=3)
    ax.set_title(title, color=color, fontsize=13, pad=5)
    ax.set_xlim(-2, 2)
    ax.set_ylim(-2, 2)
    ax.set_xticks([-2, -1, 0, 1, 2])
    ax.set_yticks([-2, -1, 0, 1, 2])
    ax.axhline(0, color='#cccccc', lw=0.9, zorder=1)
    ax.axvline(0, color='#cccccc', lw=0.9, zorder=1)
    ax.set_facecolor('none')
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=8, colors='#666666', length=3)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_color('#cccccc')
        spine.set_linewidth(0.9)

fig.tight_layout(pad=1.5)
plt.show()
```

:::

## La intersección del polinomio {.title-line}

```{python}
#| echo: false
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

_x_ic  = np.linspace(-2, 2, 400)
_gold_ic = 'goldenrod'
_crim_ic = '#c0392b'

def _setup_ic(ax):
    ax.set_xlim(-2, 2)
    ax.set_ylim(-4, 4)
    ax.set_xticks([-2, -1, 0, 1, 2])
    ax.set_yticks([-4, -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4])
    ax.axhline(0, color='#cccccc', lw=0.8, zorder=1)
    ax.axvline(0, color='#cccccc', lw=0.8, zorder=1)
    ax.set_facecolor('none')
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=8, colors='#555555', length=3)
    for sp in ax.spines.values():
        sp.set_color('#cccccc')
        sp.set_linewidth(0.9)
```

## Suma de polinomios {.title-line}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding-right: 3.5em;"}

::: {.r-stack style="flex: 1; min-height: 0; width: 100%;"}

::: {style="background: white; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-start; padding: 2em 2em; gap: 0;"}

::: {style="margin: -0.3em 0;"}
$$\left({3-5\color{teal}x}+\frac{5}{6}{\color{teal}{x^2}}+{12.4\color{teal}{x^3}}\right) + \left({2\color{teal}{x}}+{\color{teal}{x^3}}\right) =$$
:::

:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=1 style="background: white; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-start; padding: 2em 2em; gap: 0;"}

::: {style="margin: -0.3em 0;"}
$$\left(3+\boxed{-5\color{teal}{x}}+\frac{5}{6}{\color{teal}{x^2}}+12.4{\color{teal}{x^3}}\right) + \left(\boxed{2{\color{teal}{x}}}+{\color{teal}x^3}\right) =$$
:::

:::

$$({\color{#c0392b}x^5} + 2{\color{#c0392b}x}{\color{blue}y} + {\color{blue}y^2})({\color{#c0392b}x} - 3{\color{#c0392b}x}{\color{blue}y})$$

:::

```{python}
_x_en = np.linspace(-4, 4, 400)

def _plot_en(ax):
    ax.plot(_x_en, np.exp(_x_en), color=_gold_en, lw=2.2, zorder=3)
    ax.set_xlim(-4.3, 4.3)

    ax.set_xlabel('x', fontsize=10)
    ax.set_ylabel('y', fontsize=10, rotation=0, labelpad=12)
    ax.set_xticks([-4, -2, 0, 2, 4])
    ax.set_yticks([0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60])
    ax.set_facecolor('none')
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=9)
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
```

## ¿De dónde viene $e$?

```{python}
#| echo: false
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

def _e_tbl(ax, with_data=False):
    ax.axis('off')
    if with_data:
        rows = [['1',  '2.00000', '0.718282'],
                ['2',  '2.25000', '0.468282'],
                ['5',  '2.48832', '0.229962'],
                ['10', '2.59374', '0.124539']]
    else:
        rows = [['', '', ''], ['', '', ''], ['', '', ''], ['', '', '']]
    tbl = ax.table(
        cellText=rows,
        colLabels=['n', r'$\tilde{e}$', r'$e - \tilde{e}$'],
        cellLoc='center', loc='center',
        bbox=[0, 0.05, 1, 0.88]
    )
    tbl.auto_set_font_size(False)
    _cc = ['navy', 'goldenrod', 'goldenrod']
    for (row, col), cell in tbl.get_celld().items():
        cell.set_edgecolor('#aaaaaa')
        cell.set_facecolor('none')
        if row == 0:
            cell.get_text().set_color(_cc[col])
            cell.get_text().set_fontweight('bold')
            cell.get_text().set_fontsize(22)
        elif with_data:
            cell.get_text().set_color(_cc[col])
            cell.get_text().set_fontsize(22)
```

## El número $e$ en la naturaleza {.title-line}

```{python}
#| echo: false
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Circle, Rectangle, Polygon
import numpy as np

_W, _H = 13.5, 5.4

def _bfig(w=_W, h=_H):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(w, h))
    ax.set_xlim(0, w); ax.set_ylim(0, h)
    ax.axis('off')
    fig.patch.set_alpha(0); ax.set_facecolor('none')
    return fig, ax

def _bank_icon(ax, cx, cy, s, c, bg):
    """Dibuja un edificio de banco con patches (pedestal, cuerpo con columnas, techo)."""
    # Pedestal
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((cx - s*.48, cy - s*.44), s*.96, s*.10,
                            fc=c, ec='none', zorder=4))
    # Cuerpo
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((cx - s*.38, cy - s*.34), s*.76, s*.38,
                            fc=c, ec='none', zorder=4))
    # Separadores entre columnas (color del fondo de tarjeta = hueco visual)
    for xoff in (-0.13, 0.13):
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((cx + s*xoff - s*.03, cy - s*.32),
                               s*.06, s*.34, fc=bg, ec='none', zorder=5))
    # Barra base del techo
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((cx - s*.43, cy + s*.02), s*.86, s*.07,
                            fc=c, ec='none', zorder=4))
    # Triángulo del techo
    ax.add_patch(Polygon(
        [(cx - s*.43, cy + s*.09), (cx + s*.43, cy + s*.09), (cx, cy + s*.40)],
        fc=c, ec='none', zorder=4))

def _bcard(ax, cx, cy, w, h, bg, rows):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((cx - w/2, cy - h/2), w, h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.2", facecolor=bg,
        edgecolor='white', linewidth=2.5, zorder=2))
    _bank_icon(ax, cx, cy + h * 0.39, h * 0.21, c='white', bg=bg)
    for txt, dy, fs, fw, tc in rows:
        ax.text(cx, cy + h * (dy - 0.10), txt, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=round(fs * 24 / 20), fontweight=fw, color=tc, zorder=3)

def _coin(ax, cx, cy, r, color, label, lc='white', fs=15):
    ax.add_patch(Circle((cx, cy), r, color=color, zorder=3, ec='white', lw=2))
    ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=fs, fontweight='bold', color=lc, zorder=4)

def _arr(ax, x1, x2, y, c='#888'):
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y), xytext=(x1, y),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=c, lw=2.2))
```

```{python}
fig, ax = _bfig()
ax.text(_W/2, _H - 0.35, 'Banco 3: 33.3% de interés cada 4 meses',
        ha='center', va='top', fontsize=20, color=_RED, fontweight='bold')
for i in range(4):
    c = _GRY if i == 0 else _RED
    lc = '#f1c40f' if i == 3 else 'white'
    _coin(ax, _XS[i], _H/2, 0.52, c, _VALS[i], lc=lc, fs=15)
    ax.text(_XS[i], _H/2 + 0.82, _LABS[i], ha='center', va='bottom',
            fontsize=15, color='#555')
    if i > 0:
        _arr(ax, _XS[i-1] + 0.56, _XS[i] - 0.56, _H/2, c=_RED)
        ax.text((_XS[i-1]+_XS[i])/2, _H/2 + 0.2, r'$\times\,\frac{4}{3}$',
                ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=15, color=_RED)
ax.text(_W/2, 0.55, r'$(1+\frac{1}{3})^3 \approx 2.37$',
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=15, color=_RED, fontweight='bold')
plt.tight_layout(pad=0)
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
_TEAL = '#16a085'
_NXS  = [1.0, 3.3, 5.6, 7.9, 11.0]
_NLABS_TOP = ['Ahora', r'$\frac{1}{n}$ año', r'$\frac{2}{n}$ años',
              r'$\cdots$', '1 año']
_NLABS_BOT = [r'$1$', r'$1+\frac{1}{n}$', r'$(1+\frac{1}{n})^2$',
              r'$\cdots$', r'$(1+\frac{1}{n})^n$']

def _ntl(ax, highlight=False):
    ax.text(_W/2, _H - 0.35, 'Banco n: divide el año en n períodos iguales',
            ha='center', va='top', fontsize=24, color=_TEAL, fontweight='bold')
    ax.annotate('', xy=(_NXS[-1]+0.7, _H/2), xytext=(_NXS[0]-0.7, _H/2),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#ccc', lw=1.5))
    for i, (cx, lt, lb) in enumerate(zip(_NXS, _NLABS_TOP, _NLABS_BOT)):
        if lt == r'$\cdots$':
            ax.text(cx, _H/2, r'$\cdots$', ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=20, color='#aaa')
            ax.text(cx, _H/2 - 0.75, r'$\cdots$', ha='center', va='top',
                    fontsize=20, color='#aaa')
            continue
        lc_val = '#f1c40f' if (highlight and i == len(_NXS)-1) else 'white'
        _coin(ax, cx, _H/2, 0.44, _TEAL, '', fs=11)
        ax.text(cx, _H/2 + 0.68, lt, ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=17.5, color='#555')
        ax.text(cx, _H/2 - 0.68, lb, ha='center', va='top', fontsize=17.5,
                color=lc_val if highlight and i == len(_NXS)-1 else _TEAL)

fig, ax = _bfig()
_ntl(ax)
plt.tight_layout(pad=0)
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
_NE_CXS = [1.5, 3.5, 5.5, 7.0, 8.3, 9.3, 10.0, 10.7, 11.4, 12.0, 12.6]
_NE_SZS = [1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.72, 0.72, 0.52, 0.52, 0.42, 0.35, 0.25, 0.2]
_NE_CLR = ['#7f8c8d','#2980b9','#c0392b','#7f8c8d','#2980b9',
           '#c0392b','#7f8c8d','#2980b9','#c0392b','#7f8c8d','#2980b9']
_NE_BY  = 2.0
_C1   = (1.5,  1.0,  ['100% de tu dinero',  '1 vez al año'],           '#7f8c8d', 2.3)
_C2   = (3.5,  1.0,  ['1/2 de tu dinero',   '2 veces al año'],          '#2980b9', 2.3)
_C3   = (5.5,  1.0,  ['1/3 de tu dinero',   '3 veces al año'],          '#c0392b', 2.3)
_C12  = (9.3,  0.52, ['1/12 de tu dinero',  '12 veces al año',
                       '(cada mes)'],                                     '#2980b9', 1.9)
_C365 = (12.0, 0.52, ['1/365 de tu dinero', '365 veces al año',
                       '(cada día)'],                                    '#7f8c8d', 1.9)

def _ne_box(ax, cx, y_bot, lines, col, bw=2):
    bh = 0.15 + len(lines) * 0.30
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((cx - bw/2, y_bot), bw, bh,
        boxstyle='round,pad=0.08', fc='white', ec=col, lw=2, zorder=4))
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        ax.text(cx, y_bot + bh - 0.08 - j*0.30, ln,
                ha='center', va='top', fontsize=14, color='#333', zorder=5)

def _ne_draw(nb=0, cs=None, qm=False, si=False, nf=0, it=False):
    fig, ax = _bfig()
    sub = 'El Banco al Final del Universo' if it else 'Muchos Bancos'
    stc = '#e91e63' if it else '#2c3e50'
    ax.text(_W/2, _H - 0.15, sub, ha='center', va='top',
            fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', color=stc)
    for i in range(min(nb, len(_NE_CXS))):
        cx, s, col = _NE_CXS[i], _NE_SZS[i], _NE_CLR[i]
        _bank_icon(ax, cx, _NE_BY, s, col, 'white')
    if nb >= 6 and not qm:
        ax.text(13.1, _NE_BY, '···', ha='left', va='center',
                fontsize=14, color='#bbb')
    if cs:
        for (cx, s, lines, col, bw) in cs:
            top = _NE_BY + s * 0.50
            ax.plot([cx, cx], [top, top + 0.22], color=col, lw=1.5, zorder=3)
            _ne_box(ax, cx, top + 0.22, lines, col, bw)
    if qm:
        ax.add_patch(Circle((12.85, _NE_BY + 0.5), 0.32,
                            fc='#f5f5f5', ec='#555', lw=2, zorder=3))
        ax.text(12.85, _NE_BY + 0.5, '?', ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', color='#555', zorder=4)
    if si:
        icx, icy = 11.8, 4.5
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((icx-1.0, icy-0.65), 2.0, 1.30,
                               fc='#fce4ec', ec='#e91e63', lw=2.5,
                               linestyle='--', zorder=3))
        _bank_icon(ax, icx, icy+0.10, 0.55, '#e91e63', '#fce4ec')
        ax.text(icx, icy-0.40, 'Banco', ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='#e91e63', zorder=5)
        ax.text(icx, icy-0.57, r'$n\to\infty$', ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=10, color='#e91e63', zorder=5)
        for bi in [0, 5, 10]:
            if bi < nb and bi < len(_NE_CXS):
                bx = _NE_CXS[bi]; bs = _NE_SZS[bi]
                ax.plot([bx, icx], [_NE_BY + bs*0.44, icy - 0.65],
                        color='#e91e63', lw=1.2, linestyle='--',
                        alpha=0.35, zorder=2)
    _FD = [
        (r'$(1+1)^1 = 2$',                  '#7f8c8d'),
        (r'$(1+\frac{1}{2})^2 = 2.25$',     '#2980b9'),
        (r'$(1+\frac{1}{3})^3 = 2.37$',     '#c0392b'),
        (r'$(1+\frac{1}{12})^{12} = 2.613$','#e67e22'),
    ]
    for k in range(nf):
        ax.text(1.5 + k*3.0, 0.42, _FD[k][0], ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=13, color=_FD[k][1])
    plt.tight_layout(pad=0)
    return fig
```

## Convergencia a $e$ {.title-line}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding-right: 3em;"}
::: {.r-stack style="flex: 1; min-height: 0; width: 100%;"}

::: {style="background: white; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;"}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| results: 'hide'
_ROWS_PART = [
    ['1',  '2.00000'],
    ['2',  '2.25000'],
    ['3',  '2.37037'],
    ['12', '2.61304'],
]
_ROWS_FULL = _ROWS_PART + [
    ['100',    '2.70481'],
    ['1 000',  '2.71692'],
    ['10 000', '2.71815'],
    [r'$\infty$', r'$e = 2.71828...$'],
]

def _ctbl(ax, rows, hl=False):
    ax.axis('off')
    tbl = ax.table(
        cellText=rows,
        colLabels=['n', r'$(1+1/n)^n$'],
        cellLoc='center', loc='center',
        bbox=[0.02, 0.02, 0.96, 0.94]
    )
    tbl.auto_set_font_size(False)
    for (r, c), cell in tbl.get_celld().items():
        cell.set_edgecolor('#cccccc')
        cell.set_facecolor('none')
        if r == 0:
            cell.get_text().set_color(_TEAL)
            cell.get_text().set_fontweight('bold')
            cell.get_text().set_fontsize(15)
        else:
            last = hl and r == len(rows)
            cell.get_text().set_color('#e91e63' if last else '#333')
            cell.get_text().set_fontsize(15)
            cell.get_text().set_fontweight('bold' if last else 'normal')

fig, (axL, axR) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(_W, _H))
fig.patch.set_alpha(0)
axL.set_facecolor('none'); axR.set_facecolor('none')
_ctbl(axL, _ROWS_PART)
axR.axis('off')
axR.text(0.5, 0.62, r'¿Hacia dónde converge?',
         ha='center', va='center', transform=axR.transAxes,
         fontsize=20, color='#555', style='italic')
axR.text(0.5, 0.38, r'$(1+\frac{1}{n})^n \to\, ?$',
         ha='center', va='center', transform=axR.transAxes,
         fontsize=20, color=_TEAL, fontweight='bold')
plt.tight_layout(pad=0.5)
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

def _ln_fig(dot_xy=None):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.0, 7.5))
    fig.patch.set_alpha(0)
    ax.set_facecolor('none')
    x = np.linspace(0.001, 4, 3000)
    ax.plot(x, np.log(x), color='goldenrod', linewidth=2.5, zorder=2)
    ax.set_xlim(-1, 4)
    ax.set_ylim(-7, 2)
    ax.set_xlabel('x', fontsize=10)
    ax.set_ylabel('y', fontsize=10, rotation=0, labelpad=12)
    ax.axhline(0, color='#444', linewidth=0.8)
    ax.axvline(0, color='#444', linewidth=0.8)
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=9)
    ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
    if dot_xy is not None:
        ax.scatter([dot_xy[0]], [dot_xy[1]], s=320,
                   color='goldenrod', alpha=0.55, zorder=5, edgecolors='none')
    return fig, ax
```

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

def _lr_fig(show_yx=False):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.0, 7.5))
    fig.patch.set_alpha(0)
    ax.set_facecolor('none')
    x_e = np.linspace(-4, np.log(4), 400)
    ax.plot(x_e, np.exp(x_e), color='goldenrod', lw=2.5, label='exp(x)')
    x_l = np.linspace(0.018, 4, 400)
    ax.plot(x_l, np.log(x_l), color='#c0392b', lw=2.5, label='ln(x)')
    if show_yx:
        ax.plot([-4, 4], [-4, 4], color='#888', lw=1.5, ls='--', zorder=1)
    ax.set_xlim(-4, 4); ax.set_ylim(-4, 4)
    ax.set_xlabel('x', fontsize=10)
    ax.set_ylabel('y', fontsize=10, rotation=0, labelpad=12)
    ax.axhline(0, color='#444', lw=0.8); ax.axvline(0, color='#444', lw=0.8)
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=9)
    ax.legend(fontsize=10, framealpha=0, loc='upper left')
    ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
    return fig, ax
```

```{python}
    ax.set_xlabel('x', fontsize=10)
    ax.set_ylabel('y', fontsize=10, rotation=0, labelpad=12)
    ax.axhline(0, color='#444', lw=0.8)
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=9)
    ax.legend(fontsize=10, framealpha=0, loc='lower right')
    ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
    return fig, ax
```

- Las principales funciones trigonométricas y cómo se definen.
:::

::: {style="color: navy; font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.05em;"}

## Definición de funciones trigonométricas {.title-line}

```{python}
#| echo: false
from matplotlib.patches import Arc as _Arc

_TA = np.array([1.0, 0.5])
_TB = np.array([4.5, 4.9])
_TC = np.array([4.5, 0.5])
_ANG_RAD = np.arctan2(_TB[1] - _TA[1], _TB[0] - _TA[0])
_ANG_DEG = np.degrees(_ANG_RAD)

def _draw_tri(ax, labeled=False):
    tri = Polygon([_TA, _TB, _TC], fill=False, edgecolor='#2980b9', lw=2.8, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(tri)
    d = 0.22
    ax.plot([_TC[0]-d, _TC[0]-d, _TC[0]], [_TC[1], _TC[1]+d, _TC[1]+d],
            color='#2980b9', lw=1.8, zorder=4)
    if labeled:
        arc = _Arc(_TA, 0.9, 0.9, angle=0, theta1=0, theta2=_ANG_DEG,
                   color='#2980b9', lw=1.8, zorder=4)
        ax.add_patch(arc)
        ax.text(_TA[0]+0.62, _TA[1]+0.25, r'$\theta$', fontsize=16, color='#2980b9', zorder=5)
        mid_AB = (_TA + _TB) / 2
        perp   = np.array([-np.sin(_ANG_RAD), np.cos(_ANG_RAD)])
        lp     = mid_AB + perp * 0.35
        ax.text(lp[0], lp[1], 'Hipotenusa', fontsize=13, color='teal',
                rotation=_ANG_DEG, ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)
        mid_BC = (_TB + _TC) / 2
        ax.text(mid_BC[0]+0.32, mid_BC[1], 'Opuesto', fontsize=13,
                color='#c0392b', rotation=-90, ha='center', va='bottom', zorder=5)
        mid_AC = (_TA + _TC) / 2
        ax.text(mid_AC[0], mid_AC[1]-0.30, 'Adyacente', fontsize=13,
                color='goldenrod', ha='center', va='top', zorder=5)
        _draw_trig_formulas(ax)

def _draw_trig_formulas(ax):
    x0, fs = 5.8, 18
    data = [
        (3.8, r'$\cos(\theta)$', 'goldenrod', r'$a$', 'goldenrod', r'$h$'),
        (2.3, r'$\sin(\theta)$', '#c0392b',   r'$o$', 'goldenrod', r'$h$'),
        (0.8, r'$\tan(\theta)$', '#c0392b',   r'$o$', 'goldenrod', r'$a$'),
    ]
    for (y0, fn, cn, num, cd, den) in data:
        ax.text(x0,      y0, fn,    fontsize=fs, color='#333',  ha='left',   va='center')
        ax.text(x0+2.1,  y0, r'$=$',fontsize=fs, color='#333',  ha='center', va='center')
        ax.text(x0+3.1,  y0+0.40, num, fontsize=fs, color=cn,  ha='center', va='center')
        ax.plot([x0+2.5, x0+3.7], [y0, y0], color='#555', lw=1.8)
        ax.text(x0+3.1,  y0-0.40, den, fontsize=fs, color=cd,  ha='center', va='center')
    yt = 0.8
    ax.text(x0+4.2, yt, r'$=$', fontsize=fs, color='#333', ha='center', va='center')
    ax.text(x0+5.5, yt+0.40, r'$\sin(\theta)$', fontsize=fs-4,
            color='#2980b9', ha='center', va='center')
    ax.plot([x0+4.8, x0+6.2], [yt, yt], color='#555', lw=1.8)
    ax.text(x0+5.5, yt-0.40, r'$\cos(\theta)$', fontsize=fs-4,
            color='#2980b9', ha='center', va='center')

_CC   = np.array([2.7, 2.7])
_CR   = 2.1
_CANG = 55

def _draw_circ(ax, teal=False):
    ar = np.radians(_CANG)
    th = np.linspace(0, 2*np.pi, 300)
    ax.plot([_CC[0]-_CR-0.3, _CC[0]+_CR+0.3], [_CC[1], _CC[1]],
            color='#e0d5c0', lw=1.0, zorder=1)
    ax.plot([_CC[0], _CC[0]], [_CC[1]-_CR-0.3, _CC[1]+_CR+0.3],
            color='#e0d5c0', lw=1.0, zorder=1)
    ax.plot(_CC[0]+_CR*np.cos(th), _CC[1]+_CR*np.sin(th),
            color='black', lw=2.0, zorder=2)
    P  = _CC + _CR * np.array([np.cos(ar), np.sin(ar)])
    Rv = np.array([P[0], _CC[1]])
    ax.plot([_CC[0], Rv[0]], [_CC[1], Rv[1]], color='#2980b9', lw=2.5, zorder=3)
    ax.plot([Rv[0],  P[0]],  [Rv[1],  P[1]],  color='#2980b9', lw=2.5, zorder=3)
    ax.plot([_CC[0], P[0]],  [_CC[1], P[1]],  color='#2980b9', lw=2.5, zorder=3)
    d = 0.11
    ax.plot([Rv[0]-d, Rv[0]-d, Rv[0]], [Rv[1], Rv[1]+d, Rv[1]+d],
            color='#2980b9', lw=1.8, zorder=4)
    arc_th = _Arc(_CC, 0.55, 0.55, angle=0, theta1=0, theta2=float(_CANG),
                  color='#2980b9', lw=1.8, zorder=4)
    ax.add_patch(arc_th)
    ax.text(_CC[0]+0.32, _CC[1]+0.12, r'$\theta$', fontsize=15, color='#2980b9', zorder=5)
    if teal:
        ax.plot(_CC[0]+_CR*np.cos(th), _CC[1]+_CR*np.sin(th),
                color='teal', lw=5.5, alpha=0.85, zorder=5)
        ax.annotate('', xy=(_CC[0]+0.35, _CC[1]-_CR-0.08),
                    xytext=(_CC[0]-0.35, _CC[1]-_CR-0.08),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='teal', lw=2.2,
                                   connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.5'))
        ax.text(_CC[0]+0.72, _CC[1]-_CR-0.50, r'$2\pi$', fontsize=18,
                color='teal', fontweight='bold', zorder=6)

def _draw_sine(ax):
    sx_l, sx_r, sy_b, sy_t = 6.8, 13.1, 0.85, 4.55
    ym = (sy_b + sy_t) / 2
    def x2s(v): return sx_l + (v + 2*np.pi) / (4*np.pi) * (sx_r - sx_l)
    def y2s(v): return ym + v * (sy_t - sy_b) / 2
    xd = np.linspace(-2*np.pi, 2*np.pi, 600)
    ax.plot(x2s(xd), y2s(np.sin(xd)), color='goldenrod', lw=2.5, zorder=3)
    ax.plot([sx_l, sx_r], [ym, ym], color='#666', lw=0.8, zorder=2)
    x0s = x2s(0)
    ax.plot([x0s, x0s], [sy_b-0.1, sy_t+0.15], color='#666', lw=0.8, zorder=2)
    for yv, yt in [(-1, r'$-1$'), (0, r'$0$'), (1, r'$1$')]:
        ys = y2s(yv)
        ax.text(x0s-0.22, ys, yt, ha='right', va='center', fontsize=10, color='#444')
        ax.plot([x0s-0.1, x0s+0.1], [ys, ys], color='#666', lw=0.8)
    for xv, xt in [(-2*np.pi, r'$-2\pi$'), (-np.pi, r'$-\pi$'),
                    (np.pi, r'$\pi$'), (2*np.pi, r'$2\pi$')]:
        xs = x2s(xv)
        ax.text(xs, ym-0.28, xt, ha='center', va='top', fontsize=10, color='#444')
        ax.plot([xs, xs], [ym-0.1, ym+0.1], color='#666', lw=0.8)
```

## Animación de $\sin$ y $\cos$ {.title-line}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding-right: 3em; align-items: center; justify-content: center;margin-top: -1em;"}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| results: 'hide'
from mpl_toolkits.mplot3d import Axes3D          # noqa: F401
from mpl_toolkits.mplot3d.art3d import Poly3DCollection
from matplotlib.animation import FuncAnimation
from IPython.display import HTML

A     = 1.0
omega = 1.0
T     = 2 * np.pi / omega
N     = 180
t     = np.linspace(0, 2.5 * T, N)
theta = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 400)

fig    = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
ax     = fig.add_subplot(111, projection='3d')
t_max  = t[-1]
y_wall =  A * 1.3
z_fl   = -A * 1.3
arc_r  =  0.32

pk = dict(alpha=0.12, facecolor='lightcyan', edgecolor='steelblue', linewidth=1.5)
ax.add_collection3d(Poly3DCollection(
    [[(0, -A*1.1, -A*1.1), (0, y_wall, -A*1.1),
      (0, y_wall,  A*1.15), (0, -A*1.1, A*1.15)]],
    alpha=0.10, facecolor='lightyellow', edgecolor='steelblue', linewidth=1.5))
ax.add_collection3d(Poly3DCollection(
    [[(0, y_wall, A*1.15), (t_max, y_wall, A*1.15),
      (t_max, y_wall, -A*1.1), (0, y_wall, -A*1.1)]], **pk))
ax.add_collection3d(Poly3DCollection(
    [[(0, -A*1.1, z_fl), (t_max, -A*1.1, z_fl),
      (t_max, y_wall, z_fl), (0, y_wall, z_fl)]], **pk))

ax.plot(t, A*np.cos(omega*t), A*np.sin(omega*t), 'b-', linewidth=2, alpha=0.25)
ax.plot(np.zeros_like(theta), A*np.cos(theta), A*np.sin(theta), 'b-', linewidth=2.2)
ax.plot([0,0], [-A*1.05, A*1.05], [0,0], 'k-', linewidth=1.5)
ax.plot([0,0], [0,0], [-A*1.05, A*1.15], 'k-', linewidth=1.5)
ax.plot(t, np.full_like(t, y_wall), A*np.sin(omega*t), 'b-', linewidth=1.8, alpha=0.35)
ax.plot([0,0], [y_wall, y_wall], [-A*1.0, A*1.1], 'k-', linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.7)
ax.plot(t, A*np.cos(omega*t), np.full_like(t, z_fl), 'g-', linewidth=1.8, alpha=0.35)
ax.plot([0,0], [-A*1.0, A*1.0], [z_fl, z_fl], 'k-', linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.7)

for label, tv in [('T', T), ('2T', 2*T)]:
    ax.plot([tv,tv], [y_wall, y_wall], [-A*1.05, -A*0.92], 'k-', linewidth=1)
    ax.text(tv, y_wall*1.04, -A*1.2, label, fontsize=9, ha='center')
    ax.plot([tv,tv], [A*1.02, A*1.08], [z_fl, z_fl], 'k-', linewidth=1)

ax.text(t_max+0.3, 0, 0,                     r'$t\ [\mathrm{s}]$',      fontsize=11)
ax.text(0, -A*0.05, A*1.28,                   r'$\mathrm{Im}$',           fontsize=12)
ax.text(0,  A*1.12, 0.05,                      r'$\mathrm{Re}$',           fontsize=12)
ax.text(t_max*0.5, y_wall*1.03, A*1.1,         r'$y(t)=A\sin(\omega t)$', color='blue', fontsize=11)
ax.text(t_max*0.5, A*0.65, z_fl-0.15,          r'$x(t)=A\cos(\omega t)$', color='blue', fontsize=11)
ax.text(-0.5, -A*0.15, A*0.75,                 r'$z(t)=Ae^{i\omega t}$',  color='blue', fontsize=10, style='italic')

helix_dot,   = ax.plot([], [], [], 'o', color='crimson', markersize=9,  zorder=10)
sine_dot,    = ax.plot([], [], [], 'o', color='crimson', markersize=7,  zorder=10)
cos_dot,     = ax.plot([], [], [], 'o', color='crimson', markersize=7,  zorder=10)
circ_dot,    = ax.plot([], [], [], 'o', color='crimson', markersize=7,  zorder=10)
radius_line, = ax.plot([], [], [], 'b-',  linewidth=1.8)
arc_line,    = ax.plot([], [], [], 'b-',  linewidth=1.2)
im_line,     = ax.plot([], [], [], color='steelblue', linewidth=1.8)
proj_sine,   = ax.plot([], [], [], 'r--', linewidth=1.3, alpha=0.9)
proj_cos,    = ax.plot([], [], [], 'r--', linewidth=1.3, alpha=0.9)
proj_circ,   = ax.plot([], [], [], 'r--', linewidth=1.3, alpha=0.9)
trace_line,  = ax.plot([], [], [], 'k-', linewidth=2.5, alpha=0.85)

def update(frame):
    ti  = t[frame]
    yc  = A * np.cos(omega * ti)
    zc  = A * np.sin(omega * ti)
    ang = (omega * ti) % (2 * np.pi)
    helix_dot.set_data_3d([ti], [yc], [zc])
    sine_dot.set_data_3d( [ti], [y_wall], [zc])
    cos_dot.set_data_3d(  [ti], [yc], [z_fl])
    circ_dot.set_data_3d( [0],  [yc], [zc])
    radius_line.set_data_3d([0, 0], [0, yc], [0, zc])
    arc_a = np.linspace(0, ang, 60)
    arc_line.set_data_3d(np.zeros(60), arc_r*np.cos(arc_a), arc_r*np.sin(arc_a))
    im_line.set_data_3d([0, 0], [yc, yc], [0, zc])
    proj_sine.set_data_3d( [ti, ti], [yc, y_wall], [zc, zc])
    proj_cos.set_data_3d(  [ti, ti], [yc, yc],     [zc, z_fl])
    proj_circ.set_data_3d( [0,  ti], [yc, yc],     [zc, zc])
    trace_line.set_data_3d(t[:frame+1],
                           A*np.cos(omega*t[:frame+1]),
                           A*np.sin(omega*t[:frame+1]))
    return (helix_dot, sine_dot, cos_dot, circ_dot,
            radius_line, arc_line, im_line,
            proj_sine, proj_cos, proj_circ, trace_line)

ax.view_init(elev=22, azim=-55)
ax.set_xlim([0, t_max])
ax.set_ylim([-A*1.3, A*1.7])
ax.set_zlim([-A*1.7, A*1.4])
ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_zticks([])
ax.set_box_aspect([2.5, 1, 1])
ax.grid(False)
ax.xaxis.pane.fill = False
ax.yaxis.pane.fill = False
ax.zaxis.pane.fill = False
ax.xaxis.pane.set_edgecolor('black')
ax.yaxis.pane.set_edgecolor('black')
ax.zaxis.pane.set_edgecolor('black')

anim = FuncAnimation(fig, update, frames=N, interval=40, repeat=True, blit=False)
import base64, tempfile, os
_tmp = tempfile.mktemp(suffix='.gif')
anim.save(_tmp, writer='pillow', fps=25, dpi=100)
plt.close()
with open(_tmp, 'rb') as _f:
    _b64 = base64.b64encode(_f.read()).decode()
os.remove(_tmp)
HTML(f'<img src="data:image/gif;base64,{_b64}" style="width:95%; height:auto; display:block; margin:0 auto;" />')
```

## Trigonometría {.title-line}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, base64, tempfile, os
from IPython.display import HTML

_GOLD_TR = '#B8860B'
_RED_TR  = '#c0392b'
_BLUE_TR = 'steelblue'
_THETA_TR = np.radians(65)

def _trig_left():
    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(5.0, 5.5))
    x = np.linspace(0, 2*np.pi, 300)
    for ax, fn, col, lbl in [(ax1, np.cos, _GOLD_TR, 'cos(x)'), (ax2, np.sin, _RED_TR, 'sin(x)')]:
        ax.plot(x, fn(x), color=col, lw=2.5)
        ax.axhline(0, color='black', lw=0.8)
        ax.axhline( 1, color=col, lw=0.8, ls='--', alpha=0.5)
        ax.axhline(-1, color=col, lw=0.8, ls='--', alpha=0.5)
        ax.set_xlim(0, 2*np.pi); ax.set_ylim(-1.3, 1.3)
        ax.set_xticks([0, np.pi/2, np.pi, 3*np.pi/2, 2*np.pi])
        ax.set_xticklabels(['0', 'π/2', 'π', '3π/2', '2π'], fontsize=10)
        ax.set_ylabel(lbl, color=col, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
        ax.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=9)
        ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False); ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.5)
    return fig

def _circ_ax(ax):
    th = np.linspace(0, 2*np.pi, 300)
    ax.plot(np.cos(th), np.sin(th), 'k-', lw=1.8)
    ax.axhline(0, color=_GOLD_TR, lw=2.0)
    ax.axvline(0, color=_RED_TR, lw=2.0)
    ax.text( 1.2, 0,   'cos', color=_GOLD_TR, fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', va='center')
    ax.text( 0,   1.2, 'sin', color=_RED_TR,  fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', ha='center')
    ax.set_xlim(-1.5, 1.5); ax.set_ylim(-1.5, 1.5)
    ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')

def _trig_circ_base():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 4.5))
    _circ_ax(ax); fig.tight_layout(); return fig

def _trig_circ_dot():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 4.5))
    _circ_ax(ax)
    cx, cy = np.cos(_THETA_TR), np.sin(_THETA_TR)
    ax.plot([cx, cx], [0, cy], color=_BLUE_TR, lw=2.0, ls='-')
    ax.plot([0, cx], [cy, cy], color=_BLUE_TR, lw=2.0, ls='--')
    ax.plot(cx, cy, 'o', color=_BLUE_TR, ms=9, zorder=5)
    arc = np.linspace(0, _THETA_TR, 50)
    ax.plot(0.28*np.cos(arc), 0.28*np.sin(arc), color='gray', lw=1.2)
    ax.text(0.32, 0.1, 'θ', fontsize=12, color='gray')
    fig.tight_layout(); return fig

def _b64png(fig, dpi=130):
    _tmp = tempfile.mktemp(suffix='.png')
    fig.savefig(_tmp, dpi=dpi, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
    plt.close(fig)
    with open(_tmp, 'rb') as _f: _d = base64.b64encode(_f.read()).decode()
    os.remove(_tmp); return _d
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
```

```{python}
from matplotlib.patches import Polygon as _PolyID

_GID = '#B8860B'
_RID = '#c0392b'
_BID = 'steelblue'
_THI = np.radians(65)
_CXI, _CYI = np.cos(_THI), np.sin(_THI)

def _circ_id(ax):
    _th = np.linspace(0, 2*np.pi, 300)
    ax.plot(np.cos(_th), np.sin(_th), 'k-', lw=1.8)
    ax.axhline(0, color=_GID, lw=1.5)
    ax.axvline(0, color=_RID, lw=1.5)
    ax.text(1.17, 0, 'cos', color=_GID, fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', va='center')
    ax.text(0, 1.17, 'sin', color=_RID, fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', ha='center')
    ax.set_xlim(-1.5, 1.5); ax.set_ylim(-1.5, 1.5)
    ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')

def _mk_circ_id(tri=False, labeled=False):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.3, 3.3))
    _circ_id(ax)
    if tri:
        ax.add_patch(_PolyID([[0,0],[_CXI,0],[_CXI,_CYI]],
                              fill=False, edgecolor=_BID, lw=2.0, zorder=3))
        s = 0.06
        ax.plot([_CXI-s, _CXI-s, _CXI], [0, s, s], color=_BID, lw=1.2)
        if labeled:
            ax.plot(_CXI, _CYI, 'o', color=_BID, ms=5, zorder=5)
            ax.text(_CXI+0.05, _CYI+0.04, r'$(x_2,y_2)$', fontsize=7.5, color=_BID)
            ax.text(-0.12, -0.15, r'$(x_1,y_1)$', fontsize=7.5, color=_BID)
    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.2)
```

## Identidad trigonométrica {.title-line}

::: {style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; flex:1; min-height:0; padding-right:3em; align-items:center; justify-content:center;"}

::: {style="background:white; border:1px solid #c8ccd1; border-radius:3px; padding:1.3em 2em; width:88%; font-size:0.82em; line-height:1.55;"}

**Angle sum and difference identities**

::: {style="font-size:1em; color:#54595d; margin:0.4em 0 0.7em 0; border-left:3px solid #c8ccd1; padding-left:0.6em;"}
*See also:* [Proofs of trigonometric identities § Angle sum identities]{style="color:#0645ad;"}, and [Small-angle difference]{style="color:#0645ad;"}
:::

These are also known as the *angle addition and subtraction theorems* (or *formulae*).

$$\begin{align}
\sin(\alpha + \beta) &= \sin\alpha\cos\beta + \cos\alpha\sin\beta \\[0.15em]
\sin(\alpha - \beta) &= \sin\alpha\cos\beta - \cos\alpha\sin\beta \\[0.15em]
\cos(\alpha + \beta) &= \cos\alpha\cos\beta - \sin\alpha\sin\beta \\[0.15em]
\cos(\alpha - \beta) &= \cos\alpha\cos\beta + \sin\alpha\sin\beta
\end{align}$$

These identities are summarized in the first two rows of the following table, which also includes sum and difference identities for the other trigonometric functions.

:::

::: {style="font-size:0.62em; color:#72777d; margin-top:0.35em;"}
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_trigonometric_identities
:::

:::

[En esta sesión, aprenderás]{style="color:#B8860B; font-size:1.1em; font-weight:bold;"}

- [Qué es una «función por partes».]{style="color:#c0392b; font-weight:bold;"}
- [La notación para funciones por partes.]{style="color:#1a5276; font-weight:bold;"}
- [La función por partes simple que hace al aprendizaje profundo tan poderoso!]{style="color:#17a589; font-weight:bold;"}

:::

## ¿Qué es una función por partes? {.title-line}

::: {style="display:flex; flex-direction:row; flex:1; min-height:0; padding-right:3em; gap:2em; align-items:flex-start; padding-top:1.2em; padding-left:0.3em;"}

::: {style="flex: 0 0 38%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:1.2em; font-size:1.05em;"}

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=1 style="line-height:1.5; font-weight:bold;"}
[Una función por partes es una]{style="color:#B8860B;"} [función especificada en diferentes partes.]{style="color:#c0392b;"}
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=2 style="color:#1a5276; font-weight:bold; line-height:1.5;"}
Cada parte es una función con su propio subdominio.
:::

:::

::: {style="flex:1; min-height:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; align-items:center;"}

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=3 style="font-size:1.15em;"}

$$f(x) = \begin{cases} x/2 & \text{si }\ {\color{teal}x < 0} \\[0.4em] x^2 + 1 & \text{si }\ {\color{teal}0 \leq x < 3} \\[0.4em] -\ln(x) & \text{de lo contrario} \end{cases}$$

:::

:::

:::

## Ejemplo de función por partes {.title-line}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
_EG = '#B8860B'
_ER = '#c0392b'
_ET = 'steelblue'

def _eax(ax):
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False); ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    ax.set_xlabel('x', fontsize=10); ax.set_ylabel('y', fontsize=10)
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)
    ax.axhline(0, color='k', lw=0.5); ax.axvline(0, color='k', lw=0.5)

def _e3p():
    _, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 4.0))
    x1 = np.linspace(-6, 0, 200); ax.plot(x1, x1/2, color=_EG, lw=2.5)
    x2 = np.linspace(0, 3, 100); ax.plot(x2, x2**2+1, color=_ER, lw=2.5)
    x3 = np.linspace(3, 6, 100); ax.plot(x3, -np.log(x3), color=_ET, lw=2.5)
    ax.set_xlim(-6, 6); ax.set_ylim(-4, 10); _eax(ax); plt.tight_layout(pad=0.4)

def _eabs():
    _, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 4.0))
    xn = np.linspace(-6, 0, 200); xp = np.linspace(0, 6, 200)
    ax.plot(xn, -xn, color=_EG, lw=2.5); ax.plot(xp, xp, color=_ER, lw=2.5)
    ax.set_xlim(-6, 6); ax.set_ylim(0, 6.5); _eax(ax); plt.tight_layout(pad=0.4)

def _erelu():
    _, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 4.0))
    x = np.linspace(-6, 6, 300)
    ax.plot(x, np.maximum(0, x), color=_EG, lw=2.5)
    ax.set_xlim(-6, 6); ax.set_ylim(-1, 6.5); _eax(ax); plt.tight_layout(pad=0.4)
```

## Funciones continuas y discontinuas {.title-line}

::: {style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; flex:1; min-height:0; padding-right:3em; padding-left:0.5em; gap:0.5em; font-size:1.05em;"}

[En esta sesión, aprenderás]{style="color:#B8860B; font-size:1.1em; font-weight:bold;"}

- [La diferencia entre funciones continuas y discontinuas.]{style="color:#c0392b; font-weight:bold;"}
- [La definición formal y la prueba de continuidad.]{style="color:#1a5276; font-weight:bold;"}
- [Los tres tipos de discontinuidades.]{style="color:#1a5276; font-weight:bold;"}

:::

## Funciones y sus discontinuidades {.title-line}

```{python}
#| echo: false
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

_DC2 = '#333333'
_DG2 = '#B8860B'
_DR2 = '#c0392b'
_DN2 = '#1a5276'
_DT2 = '#17a589'

def _dplot(c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6):
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 6, figsize=(14, 3.2))
    fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')
    for ax in axes:
        ax.set_facecolor('white')
        ax.tick_params(left=False, bottom=False, labelleft=False, labelbottom=False)
        for sp in ax.spines.values():
            sp.set_visible(False)
        ax.axhline(0, color='#ccc', lw=0.8)
        ax.axvline(0, color='#ccc', lw=0.8)
    lw = 2.5
    ms = 7
    x1 = np.linspace(-2, -0.05, 80)
    x2 = np.linspace(0.05, 2, 80)
    axes[0].plot(x1, -0.6 * np.ones_like(x1), color=c1, lw=lw)
    axes[0].plot(x2, 0.6 * np.ones_like(x2), color=c1, lw=lw)
    axes[0].plot(-0.05, -0.6, 'o', color=c1, ms=ms)
    axes[0].plot(0.05, 0.6, 'o', color=c1, ms=ms)
    axes[0].set_xlim(-2.3, 2.3)
    axes[0].set_ylim(-1.8, 1.8)
    x = np.linspace(-2, 2, 100)
    axes[1].plot(x, 0.7 * x, color=c2, lw=lw)
    axes[1].set_xlim(-2.3, 2.3)
    axes[1].set_ylim(-1.8, 1.8)
    x = np.linspace(-2, 2, 200)
    axes[2].plot(x, np.sin(np.pi * x / 1.8), color=c3, lw=lw)
    axes[2].set_xlim(-2.3, 2.3)
    axes[2].set_ylim(-1.8, 1.8)
    xL = np.linspace(-2, -0.12, 80)
    xR = np.linspace(0.12, 2, 80)
    axes[3].plot(xL, np.minimum(1 / xL**2, 7.5), color=c4, lw=lw)
    axes[3].plot(xR, np.minimum(1 / xR**2, 7.5), color=c4, lw=lw)
    axes[3].set_xlim(-2.3, 2.3)
    axes[3].set_ylim(-0.5, 9)
    xL2 = np.linspace(-2, -0.22, 80)
    xR2 = np.linspace(0.22, 2, 80)
    axes[4].plot(xL2, 1 / xL2, color=c5, lw=lw)
    axes[4].plot(xR2, 1 / xR2, color=c5, lw=lw)
    axes[4].set_xlim(-2.3, 2.3)
    axes[4].set_ylim(-7.5, 7.5)
    xp = np.linspace(-2, 2, 300)
    yp = xp**2
    axes[5].plot(xp[xp < -0.08], yp[xp < -0.08], color=c6, lw=lw)
    axes[5].plot(xp[xp > 0.08], yp[xp > 0.08], color=c6, lw=lw)
    axes[5].plot(0, 0, 'o', color=c6, ms=ms, mfc='white', mew=2.5)
    axes[5].set_xlim(-2.3, 2.3)
    axes[5].set_ylim(-0.3, 3.5)
    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.5, w_pad=1.0)
```

## Ejemplos de discontinuidades {.title-line}

::: {style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; width:100%;"}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| results: 'hide'
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(14, 4.5))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')

lw = 2.2
ms = 8

# ---------- 1. Discontinuidad de salto ----------
ax = axes[0]
ax.set_facecolor('white')
ax.tick_params(left=False, bottom=False, labelleft=False, labelbottom=False)
for sp in ax.spines.values():
    sp.set_visible(False)
ax.axhline(0, color='#ccc', lw=0.8)
ax.axvline(0, color='#ccc', lw=0.8)

x_left = np.linspace(-1, -0.05, 80)
x_right = np.linspace(0, 1, 80)
ax.plot(x_left, x_left/2, color='#c0392b', lw=lw)
ax.plot(x_right, x_right**2 + 1, color='#c0392b', lw=lw)
# punto abierto en (0,0) y cerrado en (0,1)
ax.plot(0, 0, 'o', color='#c0392b', ms=ms, mfc='white', mew=2)
ax.plot(0, 1, 'o', color='#c0392b', ms=ms)
ax.set_xlim(-1.2, 1.2)
ax.set_ylim(-1.2, 2.5)

# ---------- 2. Discontinuidad infinita ----------
ax = axes[1]
ax.set_facecolor('white')
ax.tick_params(left=False, bottom=False, labelleft=False, labelbottom=False)
for sp in ax.spines.values():
    sp.set_visible(False)
ax.axhline(0, color='#ccc', lw=0.8)
ax.axvline(0, color='#ccc', lw=0.8)

x_left = np.linspace(0.01, np.pi/2 - 0.08, 100)
x_right = np.linspace(np.pi/2 + 0.08, np.pi - 0.01, 100)
ax.plot(x_left, np.tan(x_left), color='#1a5276', lw=lw)
ax.plot(x_right, np.tan(x_right), color='#1a5276', lw=lw)
ax.set_xlim(-0.2, np.pi + 0.2)
ax.set_ylim(-10, 10)
ax.set_xticks([0, np.pi])
ax.set_xticklabels(['0', r'$\pi$'])

# ---------- 3. Discontinuidad removible ----------
ax = axes[2]
ax.set_facecolor('white')
ax.tick_params(left=False, bottom=False, labelleft=False, labelbottom=False)
for sp in ax.spines.values():
    sp.set_visible(False)
ax.axhline(0, color='#ccc', lw=0.8)
ax.axvline(0, color='#ccc', lw=0.8)

x = np.linspace(0.01, 6, 300)
y = (x**2 - 2*x) / (x**2 - 4)
# Separar en x < 2 y x > 2 para evitar la asíntota en x = -2 (fuera de rango) y el hueco en x=2
x1 = x[x < 2]
x2 = x[x > 2]
ax.plot(x1, (x1**2 - 2*x1) / (x1**2 - 4), color='#17a589', lw=lw)
ax.plot(x2, (x2**2 - 2*x2) / (x2**2 - 4), color='#17a589', lw=lw)
# punto abierto en x=2, y = (4-4)/(4-4) -> 0/0, pero simplificando x/(x+2) = 2/4 = 0.5
ax.plot(2, 0.5, 'o', color='#17a589', ms=ms, mfc='white', mew=2)
ax.set_xlim(-0.5, 6.5)
ax.set_ylim(-0.1, 0.9)

plt.tight_layout(pad=2.0)
plt.show()
```

::: {style="display:flex; flex-direction:row; width:100%; font-size:0.85em; font-weight:bold; text-align:center; margin-top:0.5em;"}

**Discontinuidad de salto**
:::

::: {style="width:33.33%; color:#1a5276;"}

::: {style="width:33.33%; padding:0 0.5em;"}
$$
f(x) = \begin{cases}
\dfrac{x}{2} & \text{si } x < 0 \\[0.6em]
x^{2} + 1 & \text{si } 0 \leq x < 1
\end{cases}
$$
:::

::: {style="width:33.33%; padding:0 0.5em;"}
$$
f(\theta) = \tan(\theta) = \frac{\sin(\theta)}{\cos(\theta)}
$$
:::

::: {style="width:33.33%; padding:0 0.5em;"}
$$
f(x) = \frac{x^{2} - 2x}{x^{2} - 4}
$$
:::

:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

_CGOLD = '#B8860B'
_CBLUE = '#1a5276'
_CRED  = '#c0392b'

def _cont_ax(ax):
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    ax.tick_params(left=False, bottom=False, labelleft=False, labelbottom=False)
    ax.axhline(0, color='#ccc', lw=0.8)
    ax.axvline(0, color='#ccc', lw=0.8)

def _plot_cont():
    a = 1.8
    x = np.linspace(-0.3, 3.8, 500)
    y = 0.08*x**3 - 0.5*x + 0.6*np.sin(2*x)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 4))
    fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')
    ax.set_facecolor('white')
    ax.grid(True, color='gray', alpha=0.15, linewidth=0.8)
    ax.axhline(0, color='black', linewidth=1.8, zorder=2)
    ax.axvline(0, color='black', linewidth=1.8, zorder=2)
    ax.plot(x, y, color='#0b1cb8', linewidth=2.5, zorder=3)
    y_a = 0.08*a**3 - 0.5*a + 0.6*np.sin(2*a)
    ax.plot([a, a], [0, y_a], color='gray', linewidth=1.2, linestyle='--', alpha=0.45, zorder=1)
    ax.set_xlim(-0.3, 3.8)
    ax.set_ylim(-2.0, 3.5)
    ax.set_xticks([])
    ax.set_yticks([])
    ax.text(0.1, 3.4, '$f(x)$', fontsize=18, ha='left', va='top')
    ax.text(a, 0.45, '$a$', fontsize=18, ha='center', va='top', color=_CRED)
    ax.set_xlabel('$X$', fontsize=14, labelpad=4)
    for sp in ax.spines.values():
        sp.set_visible(False)
    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.3)
    plt.show()

def _plot_inf():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.0, 3.2))
    _cont_ax(ax)
    a = 0.5
    xL = np.linspace(-3, a - 0.12, 100)
    xR = np.linspace(a + 0.12, 3, 100)
    yL = 1.5 / (xL - a)**2
    yR = 1.5 / (xR - a)**2
    ax.plot(xL, np.minimum(yL, 6), color=_CBLUE, lw=2.5)
    ax.plot(xR, np.minimum(yR, 6), color=_CBLUE, lw=2.5)
    ax.axvline(a, color='#ccc', lw=0.8)
    ax.set_xlim(-3.2, 3.2)
    ax.set_ylim(-0.5, 6.5)
    ax.text(a, -0.35, '$a$', ha='center', fontsize=11, color=_CRED)
    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.3)
    plt.show()

def _plot_rem():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.0, 3.2))
    _cont_ax(ax)
    a = 0.5
    x = np.linspace(-3, 3, 300)
    y = (x - a)**2 + 0.5
    ax.plot(x, y, color=_CBLUE, lw=2.5)
    ya = (a - a)**2 + 0.5
    ax.plot(a, ya, 'o', color=_CBLUE, ms=8, mfc='white', mew=2)
    ax.set_xlim(-3.2, 3.2)
    ax.set_ylim(-0.2, 4)
    ax.text(a, -0.25, '$a$', ha='center', fontsize=11, color=_CRED)
    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.3)
    plt.show()
```

## Definición de continuidad {.title-line}

:::: {.columns style="align-items:flex-start; margin-top:0.8em;"}

::: {style="color:#B8860B; font-weight:bold; font-size:1.35em; line-height:1.5;"}
Una función $f({\color{teal}x})$ es continua en ${\color{teal}x}={\color{#c0392b}a}$ si se cumplen las siguientes tres condiciones; de lo contrario, la función es discontinua en el punto ${\color{#c0392b}a}$.
:::

::: {.column width="50%" style="font-size:1.2em;"}

::: {style="font-size:1.3em; line-height:2.2em;"}
**1.** $\;f(\color{maroon}{a})$ está definida.

**2.** $\;\displaystyle\lim_{\color{teal}{x} \to \color{maroon}{a}} f(\color{teal}{x})$ existe.

**3.** $\;\displaystyle\lim_{\color{teal}{x} \to \color{maroon}{a}} f(\color{teal}{x}) = f(\color{maroon}{a})$.
:::

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

::: {.r-stack style="width:100%; text-align:center;"}

::: {.fragment .fade-in-then-out data-fragment-index="1"}

```{python}
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Curva general del TVI
x = np.linspace(-1.0, 7.0, 600)
y = 0.55 * np.sin(1.3 * x) + 0.35 * np.sin(2.8 * x + 0.8) + 0.42 * x + 0.25

a = 3.6
b = 5.6
fa = 0.55 * np.sin(1.3 * a) + 0.35 * np.sin(2.8 * a + 0.8) + 0.42 * a + 0.25
fb = 0.55 * np.sin(1.3 * b) + 0.35 * np.sin(2.8 * b + 0.8) + 0.42 * b + 0.25

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.8, 6.0))

ax.plot(x, y, color="#B8860B", linewidth=2.5, zorder=3)

# Ejes sutiles (líneas punteadas grises)
ax.axhline(0, color="gray", linewidth=0.9, linestyle="--", alpha=0.7, zorder=1)
ax.axvline(0, color="gray", linewidth=0.9, linestyle="--", alpha=0.7, zorder=1)

# Líneas punteadas horizontales y verticales

ax.plot([b, b], [0, fb], color="navy", linewidth=1.2, linestyle="--", zorder=2)
ax.plot([0, a], [fa, fa], color="#c0392b", linewidth=1.2, linestyle="--", zorder=2)
ax.plot([0, b], [fb, fb], color="navy", linewidth=1.2, linestyle="--", zorder=2)

# Puntos en la curva
ax.plot(a, fa, 'o', color="#c0392b", markersize=6, zorder=4)
ax.plot(b, fb, 'o', color="navy", markersize=6, zorder=4)

# Etiquetas
ax.text(-0.35, fa, r"$f(a)$", fontsize=13, ha='right', va='center', color="#c0392b")
ax.text(-0.35, fb, r"$f(b)$", fontsize=13, ha='right', va='center', color="navy")
ax.text(a, -0.35, r"$a$", fontsize=13, ha='center', va='top', color="#c0392b")
ax.text(b, -0.35, r"$b$", fontsize=13, ha='center', va='top', color="navy")

ax.set_xlim(-1.2, 7.2)
ax.set_ylim(-1.0, 4.5)
ax.set_xticks([])
ax.set_yticks([])

for spine in ax.spines.values():
```

## Teorema del valor intermedio: casos de falla {.title-line}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| results: 'hide'
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def _ivt_fail():
    a = 2.0
    b = 2.85

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.8, 6.5))
    fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')
    ax.set_facecolor('white')

    # Segmento dorado (izquierda): continuo hasta x=a
    x1 = np.linspace(-0.3, a, 200)
    y1 = 2.0 * x1 - 4.0
    ax.plot(x1, y1, color='#B8860B', lw=2.5)
    ax.plot(a, 2.0*a - 4.0, 'o', color='#B8860B', ms=8, mfc='white', mew=2.5)

    # Curva roja (centro): salta en a, sube rápidamente hasta b
    x2 = np.linspace(a, b, 200)
    y2 = 7.5*(x2 - a)**1.6 + 1.4
    ax.plot(x2, y2, color='#c0392b', lw=2.5)
    ax.plot(a, 1.4, 'o', color='#c0392b', ms=8, mfc='white', mew=2.5)

    # Segmento teal (derecha): salta en b, decrece suavemente
    x3 = np.linspace(b, 6.8, 200)
    y3 = -0.35*(x3 - b) - 1.6
    ax.plot(x3, y3, color='#1abc9c', lw=2.5)
    ax.plot(b, -1.6, 'o', color='#1abc9c', ms=8, mfc='white', mew=2.5)

    # Líneas verticales discontinuas en a y b
    ax.vlines(a, -4.5, 10, colors='#1a5276', linestyles='--', lw=1.3, alpha=0.75)
    ax.vlines(b, -4.5, 10, colors='#1a5276', linestyles='--', lw=1.3, alpha=0.75)

    # Etiquetas a y b
    ax.text(a, -4.95, '$a$', ha='center', fontsize=15, color='#1a5276')
    ax.text(b, -4.95, '$b$', ha='center', fontsize=15, color='#1a5276')

    ax.set_xlim(-0.5, 7.2)
    ax.set_ylim(-4.5, 10.5)
    ax.set_ylabel('y', fontsize=12)
    ax.set_yticks([-4, -2, 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10])
    ax.tick_params(labelbottom=False, labelsize=9)
    ax.axhline(0, color="black", linewidth=1.5, zorder=1)
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.3)
    plt.show()
```

## Teorema del valor intermedio: definición {.title-line}

::: {style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex:1; min-height:0; padding-right:3em; gap:1.2em;"}

[Teorema del valor intermedio]{style="color:#B8860B; font-size:1.4em; font-weight:bold; text-align:center;"}

[Una función que es continua en $[{\color{maroon}a},\, {\color{maroon}b}]$ tiene todos los valores entre $f({\color{maroon}a})$ y $f({\color{maroon}b})$.]{style="color:#1a5276; font-size:1.25em; font-weight:bold; text-align:center; line-height:1.6;"}

:::

## Funciones compuestas {.title-line}

```{python}
#| echo: false
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatch

_CT = '#17a589'
_CG = '#B8860B'
_CB = '#2471a3'
_CR = '#b84040'
_CN = '#283593'

def _circ(ax, cx, cy, r, c, lbl, fs=30):
    ax.add_patch(mpatch.Circle((cx, cy), r, color=c, zorder=3))
    ax.text(cx, cy, f'${lbl}$', ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=fs, color='white', fontweight='bold', style='italic', zorder=5)

def _pent(ax, cx, cy, r, c, lbl, fs=26):
    ax.add_patch(mpatch.RegularPolygon((cx, cy), numVertices=5, radius=r,
                                        orientation=np.pi/2, color=c, zorder=3))
    ax.text(cx, cy, f'${lbl}$', ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=fs, color='white', fontweight='bold', style='italic', zorder=5)

def _rect(ax, cx, cy, w, h, c, lbl, fs=30):
    ax.add_patch(mpatch.FancyBboxPatch((cx-w/2, cy-h/2), w, h,
                                        boxstyle='round,pad=0.09', color=c, zorder=3))
    ax.text(cx, cy, f'${lbl}$', ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=fs, color='white', fontweight='bold', style='italic', zorder=5)

def _trap(ax, cx, cy, wt, wb, h, c, lbl='', fs=26, zo=3):
    verts = [(cx-wb/2, cy-h/2), (cx+wb/2, cy-h/2),
             (cx+wt/2, cy+h/2), (cx-wt/2, cy+h/2)]
    ax.add_patch(mpatch.Polygon(verts, closed=True, color=c, zorder=zo))
    if lbl:
        ax.text(cx, cy, f'${lbl}$', ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fs, color='white', fontweight='bold', style='italic', zorder=5)

def _arr(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2):
    ann = ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                      arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-|>', color='#222222',
                                     lw=2.5, mutation_scale=22))
    ann.arrow_patch.set_zorder(10)

def _cf_base():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14.4, 5.4))
    fig.patch.set_facecolor('white'); ax.set_facecolor('white')
    ax.set_xlim(0, 14.4); ax.set_ylim(0, 5.4); ax.axis('off')
    y = 2.7
    _circ(ax, 1.9, y, 1.01, _CT, 'x')
    _arr(ax, 2.90, y, 3.85, y)
    _pent(ax, 5.25, y, 1.19, _CG, 'f(x)')
    _arr(ax, 6.50, y, 7.51, y)
    _rect(ax, 9.25, y, 1.94, 1.94, _CB, 'y')
    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.2)
    plt.show()

def _cf_ext():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(20.2, 5.4))
    fig.patch.set_facecolor('white'); ax.set_facecolor('white')
    ax.set_xlim(0, 20.2); ax.set_ylim(0, 5.4); ax.axis('off')
    y = 2.7
    _circ(ax, 1.35, y, 0.91, _CT, 'x')
    _arr(ax, 2.30, y, 3.21, y)
    _pent(ax, 4.56, y, 1.06, _CG, 'f(x)')
    _arr(ax, 5.70, y, 6.66, y)
    _rect(ax, 8.24, y, 1.83, 1.83, _CB, 'y')
    _arr(ax, 9.18, y, 10.21, y)
    _trap(ax, 12.06, y, 1.89, 1.39, 1.73, _CR, 'g(y)')
    _arr(ax, 13.06, y, 14.14, y)
    _rect(ax, 15.90, y, 1.83, 1.83, _CN, 'z')
    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.2)
    plt.show()

def _cf_comp():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(20.2, 8.8))
    fig.patch.set_facecolor('white'); ax.set_facecolor('white')
    ax.set_xlim(0, 20.2); ax.set_ylim(0, 9.1); ax.axis('off')
    yb = 2.4; yt = 6.4; cxc = 8.69
    # fila inferior
    _circ(ax, 1.35, yb, 0.91, _CT, 'x')
    _arr(ax, 2.30, yb, 3.21, yb)
    _pent(ax, 4.56, yb, 1.06, _CG, 'f(x)')
    _arr(ax, 5.70, yb, 6.66, yb)
    _rect(ax, 8.24, yb, 1.83, 1.83, _CB, 'y')
    _arr(ax, 9.18, yb, 10.21, yb)
    _trap(ax, 12.06, yb, 1.89, 1.39, 1.73, _CR, 'g(y)')
    _arr(ax, 13.06, yb, 14.14, yb)
    _rect(ax, 15.90, yb, 1.83, 1.83, _CN, 'z')
    # elemento compuesto arriba: trapecio con pentágono encima
    _trap(ax, cxc, yt, 2.95, 2.20, 2.54, _CR, zo=3)
    _pent(ax, cxc, yt, 1.15, _CG, 'g(f(x))', fs=20)
    # flechas diagonales
    _arr(ax, 1.53, yb + 0.93, cxc - 1.39, yt - 1.21)
    _arr(ax, cxc + 1.39, yt - 1.21, 15.90 - 0.93, yb + 0.93)
    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.2)
    plt.show()
```

$$\begin{aligned} {\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}g}(x)) &= 2(7x+3)^2 - 4 \\ &= 2(7x+3)(7x+3) - 4 \\ &= 2\left(49x^2 + 21x + 21x + 9\right) - 4 \\ &= 98x^2 + 84x + 14 \end{aligned}$$

## Notación de la inversa {.title-line}

${\color{#c0392b}f}^{-1}({\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x})) = {\color{teal}x}$

:::

${\color{#c0392b}f}^{-1}({\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x})) = {\color{teal}x}$

${\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x})^{-1} = \dfrac{1}{{\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x})}$

:::

${\color{#c0392b}f}^{-1}({\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x})) = {\color{teal}x}$

${\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x})^{-1} = \dfrac{1}{{\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x})}$

::: {style="margin-top:0.3em;"}
$3^{-1} \times 3 = \dfrac{1}{3} \times 3 = 1$
:::

:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=3 style="background:white; width:100%; height:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:flex-start; align-items:flex-start; padding-left:2.5em; padding-top:1em; gap:0.65em; font-size:1.28em;"}

${\color{#c0392b}f}^{-1}({\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x})) = {\color{teal}x}$

${\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x})^{-1} = \dfrac{1}{{\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x})}$

::: {style="margin-top:0.3em;"}
${\color{goldenrod}f}^2({\color{teal}x}) = {\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x})\,{\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x})$
:::

:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=4 style="background:white; width:100%; height:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:flex-start; align-items:flex-start; padding-left:2.5em; padding-top:1em; gap:0.65em; font-size:1.28em;"}

${\color{goldenrod}f}^2({\color{teal}x}) = {\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x})\,{\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x})$

${\color{#c0392b}f}^{-1}({\color{teal}x})\,{\color{goldenrod}f}^2({\color{teal}x}) = {\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x})$

:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=5 style="background:white; width:100%; height:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:flex-start; align-items:flex-start; padding-left:2.5em; padding-top:1em; gap:0.65em; font-size:1.28em;"}

## La idea de la función inversa {.title-line}

```{python}
#| echo: false
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatch

_IT2 = '#17a589'
_IG2 = '#B8860B'
_IB2 = '#2471a3'
_IR2 = '#b84040'

def _icirc(ax, cx, cy, r, c, lbl, fs=30):
    ax.add_patch(mpatch.Circle((cx, cy), r, color=c, zorder=3))
    ax.text(cx, cy, f'${lbl}$', ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=fs, color='white', fontweight='bold', style='italic', zorder=5)

def _ipent(ax, cx, cy, r, c, lbl, fs=26):
    ax.add_patch(mpatch.RegularPolygon((cx, cy), numVertices=5, radius=r,
                                        orientation=np.pi/2, color=c, zorder=3))
    ax.text(cx, cy, f'${lbl}$', ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=fs, color='white', fontweight='bold', style='italic', zorder=5)

def _irect(ax, cx, cy, w, h, c, lbl, fs=30):
    ax.add_patch(mpatch.FancyBboxPatch((cx-w/2, cy-h/2), w, h,
                                        boxstyle='round,pad=0.09', color=c, zorder=3))
    ax.text(cx, cy, f'${lbl}$', ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=fs, color='white', fontweight='bold', style='italic', zorder=5)

def _iarr(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2):
    ann = ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                      arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-|>', color='#222222',
                                     lw=2.5, mutation_scale=22))
    ann.arrow_patch.set_zorder(10)

def _inv_base():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12.2, 4.7))
    fig.patch.set_facecolor('white'); ax.set_facecolor('white')
    ax.set_xlim(0, 12.2); ax.set_ylim(0, 4.7); ax.axis('off')
    y = 2.35
    _icirc(ax, 1.5, y, 0.84, _IT2, 'x')
    _iarr(ax, 2.35, y, 3.21, y)
    _ipent(ax, 4.3, y, 0.97, _IG2, 'f(x)')
    _iarr(ax, 5.33, y, 6.28, y)
    _irect(ax, 7.6, y, 1.59, 1.59, _IB2, 'y')
    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.2)
    plt.show()

def _inv_cycle():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12.2, 7.4))
    fig.patch.set_facecolor('white'); ax.set_facecolor('white')
    ax.set_xlim(0, 12.2); ax.set_ylim(0, 7.4); ax.axis('off')
    cx, cy = 2.0, 3.8
    fx, fy = 6.1, 6.1
    yx, yy = 10.1, 3.8
    ix, iy = 6.1, 1.2
    _icirc(ax, cx, cy, 0.84, _IT2, 'x')
    _ipent(ax, fx, fy, 0.97, _IG2, 'f(x)')
    _irect(ax, yx, yy, 1.59, 1.59, _IB2, 'y')
    _ipent(ax, ix, iy, 0.97, _IR2, 'f^{-1}(x)', fs=20)
    _iarr(ax, cx+0.70, cy+0.38, fx-0.84, fy-0.43)
    _iarr(ax, fx+0.84, fy-0.43, yx-0.81, yy+0.38)
    _iarr(ax, yx-0.81, yy-0.38, ix+0.84, iy+0.43)
    _iarr(ax, ix-0.84, iy+0.43, cx+0.70, cy-0.38)
    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.2)
    plt.show()
```

::: {style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; flex:1; min-height:0; padding-right:3em; justify-content:flex-start; align-items:flex-start; padding-left:2.5em; padding-top:0.8em; gap:0.65em; font-size:1.28em;"}

${\color{#c0392b}f}^{-1}({\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x})) = {\color{teal}x}$

${\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x})^{-1} = \dfrac{1}{{\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x})}$

::: {style="margin-top:0.3em; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:0.5em;"}

${\color{goldenrod}f}^2({\color{teal}x}) = {\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x})\,{\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x})$

${\color{#c0392b}f}^{-1}({\color{teal}x})\,{\color{goldenrod}f}^2({\color{teal}x}) = {\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x})$

${\color{#c0392b}f}^{-1}({\color{teal}x})\,{\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x}) = {\color{goldenrod}f}^0({\color{teal}x})$

## Cálculo de la función inversa {.title-line}

::: {style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; flex:1; min-height:0; padding-right:3em; padding-left:0.5em; gap:0.6em; font-size:1.1em;"}

[Para calcular la inversa a mano (¡o con sympy!):]{style="color:#c0392b; font-weight:bold;"}

1) Expresa la función como ${\color{goldenrod}y} = \ldots$

2) Despeja ${\color{teal}x}$

3) Intercambia ${\color{teal}x}$ e ${\color{goldenrod}y}$

:::

## Cálculo de la inversa: ejemplo {.title-line}

::: {style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:flex-start; flex:1; min-height:0; padding-right:3em; padding-left:3.5em; padding-top:0.8em; gap:0.9em; font-size:1.18em;"}

::: {style="text-align:center; padding-left:1em;"}
${\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x}) = 2{\color{teal}x} + 3$
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=1 style="display:flex; flex-direction:row; align-items:center; gap:0.7em;"}

::: {style="color:#B8860B; font-weight:bold; min-width:4em;"}
Paso 1
:::

::: {style="color:#B8860B; font-size:1.6em; line-height:0.75; font-weight:300;"}
{
:::

::: {}
${\color{maroon}y} = 2{\color{teal}x} + 3$
:::

:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=2 style="display:flex; flex-direction:row; align-items:center; gap:0.7em;"}

::: {style="color:#B8860B; font-weight:bold; min-width:4em;"}
Paso 2
:::

::: {style="color:#B8860B; font-size:3.0em; line-height:0.75; font-weight:300;"}
{
:::

::: {style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:0.35em;"}

${\color{maroon}y} - 3 = 2{\color{teal}x}$

## Cálculo de la inversa mediante álgebra {.title-line}

```{python}
#| echo: false
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

_CGINV2 = '#B8860B'
_CRINV2 = '#c0392b'

def _inv_plot_sin():
    th = np.linspace(-1, 1, 500)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5, 6.0))
    fig.patch.set_facecolor('white'); ax.set_facecolor('white')
    ax.plot(th, np.sin(2*np.pi*th), color=_CGINV2, lw=2.5, label='$f(\\theta)$')
    ax.plot(th, np.arcsin(th)/(2*np.pi), color=_CRINV2, lw=2.5, label='$f^{-1}(\\theta)$')
    ax.axhline(0, color='#bbb', lw=0.8); ax.axvline(0, color='#bbb', lw=0.8)
    ax.set_xlim(-1, 1); ax.set_ylim(-1.15, 1.15)
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=9)
    ax.legend(fontsize=10, loc='upper right')
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False); ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.4)
    plt.show()

def _inv_plot_poly():
    xp = np.linspace(-2.5, 2.5, 400)
    xpi = np.linspace(4, 20, 400)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5, 6.0))
    fig.patch.set_facecolor('white'); ax.set_facecolor('white')
    ax.plot(xp, 3*xp**2 + 4, color=_CGINV2, lw=2.5, label='$f(x)$')
    ax.plot(xpi, np.sqrt((xpi - 4) / 3), color=_CRINV2, lw=2.5, label='$f^{-1}(x)$')
    ax.axhline(0, color='#bbb', lw=0.8); ax.axvline(0, color='#bbb', lw=0.8)
    ax.set_xlim(-4, 6); ax.set_ylim(-5, 21)
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=9)
    ax.legend(fontsize=10, loc='upper right')
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False); ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.4)
    plt.show()
```

$\arcsin({\color{maroon}y}) = 2\pi{\color{teal}\theta}$

$\dfrac{\arcsin({\color{maroon}y})}{2\pi} = {\color{teal}\theta}$

$\dfrac{\arcsin({\color{teal}\theta})}{2\pi} = {\color{maroon}f}^{-1}({\color{teal}\theta})$

$\arcsin({\color{maroon}y}) = 2\pi{\color{teal}\theta}$

$\dfrac{\arcsin({\color{maroon}y})}{2\pi} = {\color{teal}\theta}$

${\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}\theta}) = 2{\color{teal}\theta}\sin(2\pi{\color{teal}\theta})$

:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=4 style="background:white; width:100%; height:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:flex-start; padding-left:2.5em; padding-top:0.9em; gap:0.65em; font-size:1.2em;"}

${\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}\theta}) = 2{\color{teal}\theta}\sin(2\pi{\color{teal}\theta})$

$\arcsin\!\left(\dfrac{{\color{maroon}y}}{2{\color{teal}\theta}}\right) = 2\pi{\color{teal}\theta}$

$\dfrac{\arcsin\!\left(\frac{{\color{maroon}y}}{2{\color{teal}\theta}}\right)}{2\pi} = {\color{teal}\theta}$

:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=5 style="background:white; width:100%; height:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:flex-start; padding-left:2.5em; padding-top:0.9em; font-size:1.2em;"}

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=6 style="background:white; width:100%; height:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:flex-start; padding-left:2.5em; padding-top:0.9em; gap:0.55em; font-size:1.2em;"}

${\color{goldenrod}f}({\color{teal}x}) = 3{\color{teal}x}^2 + 4$

${\color{maroon}y} - 4 = 3{\color{teal}x}^2$

$\dfrac{{\color{maroon}y} - 4}{3} = {\color{teal}x}^2$

$\sqrt{\dfrac{{\color{maroon}y} - 4}{3}} = {\color{teal}x}$

$\sqrt{\dfrac{{\color{teal}x} - 4}{3}} = {\color{maroon}f}^{-1}({\color{teal}x})$

${\color{maroon}y} - 4 = 3{\color{teal}x}^2$

$\dfrac{{\color{maroon}y} - 4}{3} = {\color{teal}x}^2$

$\sqrt{\dfrac{{\color{maroon}y} - 4}{3}} = {\color{teal}x}$

$\sqrt{\dfrac{{\color{teal}x} - 4}{3}} = {\color{maroon}f}^{-1}({\color{teal}x})$
